blocks.html:
VINYL WRAP TORONTO OBJECT/EQUIPMENT WRAP

Just like vehicles, there are objects that we’re close to and want to give those objects an upgrade, simply because it’s been too long and they’ve started to seem old and boring. Getting a custom Vinyl Wrap is a great way to freshen up your objects.

Since it is not a hot trend, you won’t see a lot of agencies who would offer to wrap equipment for you. But just because there isn’t much hype about it, doesn’t mean it is not important for the people who do want it.

Here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we are open to accepting new challenges that push our boundaries and encourage us to learn something new. We have done some interesting equipment wraps over the years. From a pair of heels to heavy lifting equipment, we’ve dipped our toes in all the areas and learned something new every time.

We believe equipment wrap is interesting and unique because every object is different and most of the time has a lot of tricky curves and designs.

The equipment we use daily is without question important to us, and it makes it more interesting to be using that equipment when it’s got your own personal touch. From a personal graphic such as a logo, an inspirational quote to a complete colour change. There are countless options for you to give your equipment a cool new look.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we have professional designers who are capable of rendering your favourite graphics based on your description and installers who have years of experience wrapping complex vehicles and objects to wrap your equipment with perfection.

Over the last decade, we have wrapped some interesting objects including, high heels, lifting equipment, bobcats, trailer, laptops, hockey helmets, transponders, etc. with a lot more to come.

If you wish to give your equipment a personal touch, call us today at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1B4 to discuss your requirements and get the best equipment wrap cost in the city.
